title: Pure Chronomaly
summary: Chronomaly cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Chronomaly is an Xyz deck of Rocks and Machines with its own Number monsters. The 2021 cards lead. Chronomaly Magella Globe tributes itself to summon any Chronomaly from the Deck and comes back from the GY. Chronomaly Temple - Trilithon gives an extra Chronomaly Normal Summon and stands in for an Xyz material. Chronomaly Acambaro Figures shields your Chronomalies and revives itself. Chronomaly Esperanza Glyph targets an Xyz Monster and summons two Chronomalies one Level above its Rank, then Xyz Summons with them. A Rank 4 turns into two Level 5s for Chronomaly Vimana, which negates a monster effect. Chronomaly Nebra Disk searches any Chronomaly card, and Chronomaly Tuspa Rocket shrinks a monster by milling one. Number 36: Chronomaly Chateau Huyuk zeroes a monster on either turn.
